{{Top|leg}}
'''1240C racing engines''' were turbine engines designed by [[Radon-Ulzer/Legends|Radon-Ulzer]] specifically for [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]]. This type of engine was used by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] for his [[Anakin Skywalker's second Podracer|second custom podracer]]<ref name="Star Wars: Racer Revenge: Prima's Official Strategy Guide">[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Racer Revenge'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].<ref>[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Racer Revenge'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]] places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]'' eight years after the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] from [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], an event that was concurrent with the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' places the Battle of Naboo in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref>
